import java.util.*;

public class MaxFlowMinCost {
    static final int MAXN = 2000005;
    static int totalEdges, source, sink, nodes, edges, kValue, cValue, dValue;
    static int[] nextEdge = new int[MAXN], head = new int[MAXN], to = new int[MAXN], cap = new int[MAXN], weight = new int[MAXN], dist = new int[MAXN], flowCurr = new int[MAXN], xArr = new int[MAXN], yArr = new int[MAXN], visitedFlag = new int[MAXN];
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity, int weightVal) {
        nextEdge[++totalEdges] = head[u];
        head[u] = totalEdges;
        to[totalEdges] = v;
        cap[totalEdges] = capacity;
        weight[totalEdges] = weightVal;
        nextEdge[++totalEdges] = head[v];
        head[v] = totalEdges;
        to[totalEdges] = u;
        cap[totalEdges] = 0;
        weight[totalEdges] = -weightVal;
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        q.clear();
        q.add(source);
        dist[source] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            visitedFlag[u] = 0;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = nextEdge[i]) {
                if (cap[i] > 0 && dist[to[i]] > dist[u] + weight[i]) {
                    dist[to[i]] = dist[u] + weight[i];
                    if (visitedFlag[to[i]] == 0) {
                        visitedFlag[to[i]] = 1;
                        q.add(to[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink] <= 1000000000;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int flowIn) {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        visitedFlag[u] = 1;
        if (u == sink) return flowIn;
        for (int i = flowCurr[u]; i != 0; i = nextEdge[i]) {
            if (visitedFlag[to[i]] == 0 && cap[i] > 0 && dist[to[i]] == dist[u] + weight[i]) {
                int flowBottle = Math.min(flowIn, cap[i]);
                flowBottle = Math.min(flowIn, flowBottle);
                int pushedFlow = dfs(to[i], flowBottle);
                if (pushedFlow > 0) {
                    cap[i] -= pushedFlow;
                    cap[i ^ 1] += pushedFlow;
                    totalFlow += pushedFlow;
                    flowIn -= pushedFlow;
                    if (flowIn == 0) break;
                }
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    static int gao() {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            System.arraycopy(cap, 0, flowCurr, 0, cap.length);
            int flow;
            while ((flow = dfs(source, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                totalFlow += flow;
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        nodes = sc.nextInt();
        edges = sc.nextInt();
        kValue = sc.nextInt();
        cValue = sc.nextInt();
        dValue = sc.nextInt();

        source = 0;
        sink = 1;
        totalEdges = 1;
        Arrays.fill(head, 0);
        Arrays.fill(visitedFlag, 0);

        for (int i = 1; i <= kValue; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(source, x + 1, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= edges; i++) {
            xArr[i] = sc.nextInt();
            yArr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        int n = nodes;
        int maxNodeIndex = nodes + kValue;
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxNodeIndex; i++) {
            addEdge(2 + i * n, sink, kValue, 0);
            if (i == maxNodeIndex) break;
            for (int j = 1; j <= edges; j++) {
                for (int l = kValue; l >= 0; l--) {
                    int fromNode = xArr[j] + 1 + i * n;
                    int toNode = yArr[j] + 1 + i * n;
                    int cost = (l * 2 + 1) * dValue + cValue;
                    addEdge(fromNode, toNode, 1, cost);
                    addEdge(toNode, fromNode, 1, cost);
                }
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= nodes; j++) {
                int fromNode = j + 1 + i * n;
                int toNode = j + 1 + i * n + n;
                addEdge(fromNode, toNode, kValue, cValue);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(gao());
        sc.close();
    }
}
